for(const t of [sim.player,...sim.targets]){const p=camera.project(t.x,2.25,t.z,w,h);c.fillStyle='#07141dda';c.fillRect(p.x-27,p.y,54,6);const ghost=sim.feedback?.states.get(t.id)?.ghost;if(ghost>t.health){c.fillStyle='#d2c2a3';c.fillRect(p.x-27,p.y,54*ghost/t.maxHealth,6);}const health=t.health/t.maxHealth;c.fillStyle=t.dead?'#4d5960':health<=.15?'#ff694f':health<=.3?'#edac55':t.team===1?'#65e4ca':'#ef8c9c';c.fillRect(p.x-27,p.y,54*t.health/t.maxHealth,6);c.fillStyle=t.team===1?'#65e4ca':t.team===2?'#ef8c9c':'#ccb16f';c.fillRect(p.x-30,p.y,2,6);c.font='bold 9px Arial';c.fillStyle='#f0eeee';c.fillText(sim.match?.protected(t)?'PROTECTED':t.dead?(Number.isFinite(t.respawnAt)?'RESPAWN '+Math.max(0,Math.ceil(t.respawnAt-sim.now)):'ELIMINATED'):hasStatus(t,'stun',sim.now)?'STUNNED':hasStatus(t,'slow',sim.now)?'SLOWED':t.name||(sim.definition.name||'KIT ASHER'),p.x,p.y-6);}
